title: Audi Has 7 New Models Coming In 2026. Here's All Of Them
snippet:
The E7X is a fully electric SUV developed through Audi’s joint venture with SAIC. It shares a lot with the E5 Sportback, including its design language and powertrain, using an advanced 900-volt system that delivers up to 670 horsepower and roughly 750 kilometers (466 miles) of range on China’s CLTC cycle. It debuted in April and should hit showrooms before the end of the year.

title: 2026 Audi Q5 / Q5 Sportback Review, Pricing, and Specs
snippet:
The newest generation Audi Q5 debuted only last year, so the changes for 2026 are mostly small corrective tweaks. The most obvious change comes in the form of a new steering wheel design that brings back a physical scroll wheel in place of the previous touch-capacitive buttons. The Q5's Audi MMI infotainment interface has also been revised, making menus easier to navigate.
